plain_english: Manifestation-named consciousness, sequenceless, from void-step, outside-merged — spreads utterly as covering. Then too in inner-essence, by melted rush, sequencelessly — great Time-goddess, making all time.
sanskrit_cite: prakāśākhyā saṃvit kramavirahitā | mahākālī seyaṃ mama kalayatāṃ kālam akhilam
